item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00244","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C05","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.94,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 plausibly supplied material drafting machinery for the child. Both proclamations revise an existing national monument by excluding specifically described lands, use the same Antiquities Act authority, and impose an essentially verbatim temporary bar on appropriation of the excluded lands. The child adds a second operation—reserving other lands as part of the monument—but C01's exclusion structure and distinctive post-exclusion clause are concrete enough to establish template use.
